title: RRHF: Rank Responses to Align Language Models with Human Feedback
authors_zh: Zheng Yuan、Hongyi Yuan、Chuanqi Tan、Wei Wang、Songfang Huang、Fei Huang（阿里巴巴集团）
paper_type_zh: 排序响应驱动的轻量级偏好对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合理解多候选回答与排序反馈如何直接进入训练目标的读者。
one_line: RRHF trains a policy to rank sampled responses in the same order as feedback, using a lightweight ranking loss.
RRHF 让模型对多来源候选回答的概率排序与反馈排序一致，无需 PPO 或单独奖励模型。
why: It demonstrates that the value of feedback can be carried by an ordered candidate set rather than only by a reward model or a binary pair.
inclusion_reason: Uses ranked multi-source responses directly as a simple alignment-training signal without PPO or a separate reward model.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLHF commonly separates supervised fine-tuning, reward-model training, and PPO. That pipeline needs multiple models and can be sensitive to optimization settings, even when the feedback already says which sampled responses are better.

RRHF asks whether a policy can learn directly from an ordered candidate set. The intended training record is a prompt with responses from people or models and a ranking that the policy should reproduce in probability space.

RLHF 常把监督微调、奖励模型训练和 PPO 分开进行。即使反馈已经指出哪些采样回答更好，这条流水线仍需要多个模型，也可能对优化设置敏感。

RRHF 要问的是，策略能否直接从有序候选集合中学习。它所需的训练记录是一个提示、来自人或模型的回答，以及策略应在概率空间复现的排序。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
RRHF treats ranking as the supervision object. It scores each candidate with the policy’s conditional log probability and penalizes disagreements between that score order and the feedback order.

The candidate set can mix self-samples, outputs from other models, and human answers. This makes response quality and ranking quality distinct resources: the training signal depends on both which alternatives are supplied and how they are ordered.

RRHF 将排序视为监督对象。它用策略的条件对数概率为每个候选打分，并惩罚该分数顺序与反馈顺序不一致的情况。

候选集合可以混合自采样、其他模型输出和人类回答。这使回答质量与排序质量成为不同资源：训练信号同时取决于提供了哪些替代项，以及它们如何被排序。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a ranked set, RRHF computes log probabilities of the candidates under the current policy, then applies a ranking loss to enforce the preferred order. It can also retain an SFT-like term for the best response.

The paper evaluates on the Helpful and Harmless dataset and compares alignment outcomes with PPO-based RLHF. It also varies sampling quality, showing that the quality of available alternatives strongly affects what the rank learner can acquire.

对于一个已排序集合，RRHF 计算当前策略下各候选的对数概率，再施加排序损失以强制满足优选顺序。它还可以保留对最佳回答的类似监督微调项。

论文在 Helpful and Harmless 数据集上评估，并将对齐结果与基于 PPO 的 RLHF 比较。它也改变采样质量，说明可获得替代项的质量会强烈影响排序学习器能学到什么。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports alignment performance comparable to PPO on Helpful and Harmless under reward-model scores and human labels. Its experiments also show that RRHF behaves like a best-of-n learner: stronger sampled candidates create a stronger possible training signal.

This evidence supports a simpler consumer for ranked data, not a guarantee that rankings are noise-free or transferable. A poor candidate pool can make a correct ranking uninformative, and a biased ranker can systematically teach the wrong response style.

论文报告，在 Helpful and Harmless 上，RRHF 按奖励模型分数和人类标签衡量的对齐表现可与 PPO 相当。实验还显示 RRHF 类似 best-of-n 学习器：采样候选越强，可获得的训练信号越强。

这些证据支持一种更简单的排序数据使用方，但不保证排序无噪声或可迁移。较差的候选池会使正确排序也缺乏信息，而带偏的排序器会系统性地教出错误回答风格。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Rather than fitting a scalar reward and optimizing it through PPO, RRHF maps a response order directly onto model likelihoods. The ranking record is consumed in one lightweight tuning objective.

This changes the useful feedback format from a single preferred pair to an ordered pool. It also makes candidate generation an explicit part of the training pipeline, because a rank loss cannot prefer an answer that was never proposed.

RRHF 不再拟合标量奖励再通过 PPO 优化它，而是把回答顺序直接映射到模型似然上。排序记录在一次轻量调优目标中被消费。

这将有用反馈格式从单一优选对扩展为有序候选池。它也让候选生成成为训练流水线的显式部分，因为排序损失无法偏好从未被提出的答案。

title: Limitations
局限
html: RRHF is constrained by candidate diversity and quality, and its ranking loss may favor length or surface style when rankings encode those artifacts. It does not solve disagreement among judges, so the provenance of candidates and rank labels must be retained for auditing.
RRHF 受候选多样性和质量约束；当排序编码了长度或表面风格伪影时，其排序损失可能偏好这些伪影。它并未解决评审器之间的分歧，因此必须保留候选和排序标签的来源以便审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use RRHF when feedback naturally orders more than two alternatives and a full reward-model/PPO stack is unnecessary. It helps decide whether to retain the entire candidate pool rather than collapsing feedback immediately into one chosen/rejected pair.
当反馈天然可对两个以上替代项排序、且不需要完整奖励模型/PPO 栈时，可使用 RRHF。它有助于决定是否保留整个候选池，而不是立刻把反馈压缩为一个优选/拒选对。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Inspect where candidates came from, how ties are handled, how ranks were acquired, and whether log probabilities are length-normalized. The sampling-quality analysis is essential: it identifies candidate generation, not just the loss, as a limiting training decision.
应检查候选来自哪里、平局如何处理、排序如何获得，以及对数概率是否做长度归一化。采样质量分析十分关键：它指出限制训练的决定不仅是损失函数，还包括候选生成。
